Overview

Shadowgirl (Time Traveller) is a Secret Limited unit​. She can only be obtained by evolving Shadowgirl​.

Evolving

Shadowgirl (Time Traveller) can be evolved from Shadowgirl with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Shadowgirl
x1 Soul Gem (Violet)
Result
Shadowgirl (Time Traveller)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5,000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Attacks starting from Upgrade 7 are able to hit air type enemies. She also has dark as her secondary.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

    • She is the first Limited Unit to get buffed.
    • She is the first Unit to get buffed more than once upon debut.
  • During Update 13.5.0, her Final Measure attack's AoE size got buffed, and her Timestop active on upgrade 3 buffed from 42s -> 28s.
    • Also during Update 13.5.0, her Final Measure ability cooldown got buffed from 28 -> 15s. Her Final Measure attack cooldown and damage rebalanced (same dps, lower cd) as well (It used to have 19 SPA, 18 SPA on max).



  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
